title.zh: 公司文档问答，怎么选方案？
title.en: Which route fits an internal document assistant?

zh.question: 团队要让 AI 回答公司内部 PDF 和 Word 文档里的问题，回答需标明来源，找不到依据时说明不知道，希望在公司自己的服务器部署。
zh.headline: 建议先用 Dify
zh.summary: 先用 Dify 处理本次的文档问答应用与知识库平台任务。现有资料覆盖必要功能。

reasons.finding: Dify 知识库官方教程说明可导入 PDF、DOCX 等文档并分块索引。中文、扫描件解析准确性仍需用自己的样本验证；支持导入不等于回答准确。
Dify 官方知识库流程包括文档分块、索引和检索配置，并可连接到应用。它是应用搭建平台，需要配置生成与嵌入服务；不是独立模型，也不是上传文档即可保证可上线的成品问答系统。

zh.tradeoff: 这是需要配置模型与知识库的应用平台；自托管平台不代表模型也在本地。
unknowns: 缺少适用于本业务、相同样本和配置的实测；现有功能描述或其他基准不能证明。

nextAction.label: 查看上手步骤
nextAction.instruction: 先确认模型和嵌入服务的数据去向，再用少量授权 PDF / Word 文档创建知识库并接入 Chatbot，启用引用展示；固定文档、切分和检索配置，保留检索片段与最终答案。自托管平台不代表模型也在本地。 逐句核对答案和出处，检查无答案时是否明确拒答；用无权访问的文档验证隔离。 原始限制：找不到依据时说明不知道

en.question: Our team needs an AI assistant for internal PDF and Word documents, with source citations and an explicit refusal when evidence is missing. We want to host the application on our own server.
en.headline: Start with Dify
en.summary: Use Dify for this Document QA application and knowledge platform task. Current evidence covers the required features.

reasons.finding: Dify documents PDF and DOCX knowledge ingestion and indexing; Chinese and scanned-document accuracy require sample validation.

Dify provides configurable chunking, indexing and retrieval for applications; it is an application-building platform requiring model/provider setup, not an independently measured or deployment-ready answer system.

en.tradeoff: This platform needs model and knowledge-base configuration; self-hosting the platform does not make its model local.
unknowns: Comparable measurements on this business, sample and configuration are missing; descriptions or other benchmarks cannot substitute.

nextAction.label: See how to start
nextAction.instruction: Confirm where model and embedding services send data, create a knowledge base from a few authorized PDF / Word documents, connect it to a Chatbot and enable citations. Fix document, chunking and retrieval settings; retain retrieved passages and final answers. Self-hosting the platform does not make its models local. Check each answer against its cited passage, abstention on missing answers and isolation of unauthorized documents.
